column1: # fast-gate change->gate mapping (tools/fast-gate/fast-gate.sh). TAB-separated, first match
# is NOT exclusive — every matching row contributes, the plan is the UNION of matches.
#   col 1  regex matched against each `git diff --name-only` path (extended regex, anchored
#          however you write it)
#   col 2  kernel-check scope for tier-0:
#            all        full kernel-check (no env)
#            synthetic  MEMRA_KC_FAST=1 (synthetic arms only, ~2s — skips weight-oracle sections)
#            none       skip kernel-check entirely (build-only tier-0)
#            <csv>      MEMRA_KC_ONLY=<csv> (synthetic arms + only these weight-oracle sections;
#                       names = kc_model section tags: dtype5, nvfp4-gemm, q8mmq-gemm, q4_0-mmq,
#                       q4_0-sk-arm, iq4xs-mmq, f16g-kq-direct, nvfp4-27b-shape, nvfp4-mmvq,
#                       nvfp4-batched, a6-split-plane, d2-cache-bit-identity, fast-router-batch)
#   col 3  tier-1 golden argmax probes (csv of ids from models.tsv), or -
#   col 4  tier-1 spec probes (csv of ids from models.tsv), or -
# Scope union rule: none < synthetic < csv < all. Unmatched engine/runtime paths fall through
# to the DEFAULT row at the bottom (conservative: full kernel-check + one probe per model class).
# The mapping encodes the dispatch structure: which kernels serve which model classes.
# Model classes (see models.tsv): g12/g31 = gemma4 dense Q4_0; e4b shares those quant kernels
# but adds per-layer embeddings + KV sharing; g26 = gemma4 MoE Q4_0; q9 = qwen hybrid dense
# NVFP4 (hd128, GDN linear-attn); k27 = qwen dense NVFP4; q35/aw35 = qwen hybrid MoE with
# Q8_0 trunks; kat shares that arch but uniquely carries a non-expert IQ4_XS trunk; o9 = dense
# Q8_0; o35 = MoE Q4_K_M.
# --- CUDA kernels ---
^crates/memra-engine/cu/qmatvec\.cu$
^crates/memra-engine/cu/qmatvec_gemm\.cu$
^crates/memra-engine/cu/mmq_q4_0.*\.cu$
^crates/memra-engine/cu/mmq_q8_0\.cu$
^crates/memra-engine/cu/mmq_q45k\.cu$
# This TU also owns the dense IQ4_XS MMQ arm; kat is the only registered probe that reaches it.
^crates/memra-engine/cu/mmq_iq_experts\.cu$
# The NVFP4 prefill tiles are where the receipted acceptance mover lives (MEMRA_MMQ_F8F4 on
# mmq_nvfp4_w4a8.cu): a prefill-KV numeric change propagates into the DRAFT HEAD's read set,
# so it moves spec acceptance and served greedy text while every golden/self-consistency probe
# stays green (research/f8f4-flip-20260806). `accept` is the only probe that can see it.
^crates/memra-engine/cu/(mmq_fp4|mmq_nvfp4_[a-z0-9_]*|cutlass_fp4_sm120)\.cu$
# flash_attn.cu: the tier-0 synthetic arms carry the REAL teeth for the live decode arms
# (fa_decode_rows/seqs_v4 bit-identity caught a v4 K-scale skew with 46 FAILs — receipts
# break-fa-v4-*). The ~100-token text probes (q9/q35) decode at t_kv ~100-120 — above the
# 96 vec floor, inside the v4 window — so the default-module v4 hd256 arm runs; g12d adds
# the gemma fp8-KV g-module at depth (hd512 dpl16 + windowed arms, t_kv ~1740); e4b adds the
# short-window MQA + shared-KV variant. KNOWN GAP:
# helpers only consumed by non-default rollback seams (e.g. dq_K_lane's q8_0 branch — v4-off
# vec_q, smem twin, q8_0 globals under MEMRA_GEMMA_GKV=0) are DEFAULT-DEAD: invisible to
# naked probes by construction (verified: a lane-swap break there passed everything,
# break-fa-decode2-*); flipping those seams is battery/A-B territory. docs/TESTING.md.
# isogap adds the RUNG-CROSSING shape (the seqs_v4/combine_seqs ONE-PARTITION law under a
# straddle + the per-seq fallback window) that the fixed-depth synthetic pins never reach.
^crates/memra-engine/cu/(flash_attn|fa3_prefill|fattn_vendor)\.cu$
^crates/memra-engine/cu/(f16_prefill|fp8_prefill|moe_f16_grouped)\.cu$
^crates/memra-engine/cu/moe_router\.cu$
^crates/memra-engine/cu/hybrid\.cu$
# kernels.cu also hosts E4B-only per-layer-embedding glue fusions.
^crates/memra-engine/cu/kernels\.cu$
# spec_sample.cu: the golden probes are all GREEDY (temp 0) — they route around the sampled-spec
# kernels entirely, so a broken gumbel/softmax_gather/residual sampler is INVISIBLE to token
# goldens. sample-check (samp) is the on-GPU oracle for exactly these kernels.
^crates/memra-engine/cu/spec_sample\.cu$
^crates/memra-engine/cu/[a-z0-9_]*\.(cuh|inc)$
# --- engine Rust: spec/draft pipeline (spec.rs also hosts the sampled-spec host Philox mirror —
# samp oracles the device twins the greedy spec probes never run) ---
^crates/memra-engine/src/(spec|gemma_spec|dflash|eagle|round_stream)\.rs$
# --- engine Rust: MoE residency/spill. THE PROBE-REGIME LESSON (2026-08-03): on a 24GB rig
# every MoE probe model loads RESIDENT (whole bank in device slabs), so the SLRU cache, the
# staged moe_cached_gemm* loop, and the spill paths are NEVER exercised by a naked probe — a
# break there was demonstrably invisible to q35 (research/fast-gate-20260802/break-moe-staged-*).
# q35slru (MEMRA_MOE_RESIDENT=0 + capped slots) forces that dispatch class. ---
^crates/memra-engine/src/(moe_cache|spill|spill_pread|cpu_experts)\.rs$
# --- engine Rust: forward passes / graphs. kernel-check exercises Engine FFI wrappers, not
# the forward passes — synthetic arms are a cheap link-sanity check; the REAL gate for these
# files is the golden probes (three kernel classes + one spec probe). ---
# hybrid_forward.rs also hosts the staged/SLRU MoE dispatch (moe_cached_gemm*) that resident-
# fitting models never run — q35slru covers it (the probe-regime lesson, see the MoE row above).
# hybrid_forward.rs also owns the CHUNKED-PREFILL segmentation (prime_cache), whose split
# points steer the prefill's arithmetic — chunkinv/chunkinvc pin that behavior (and prove the
# gate can fail). See research/chunk-invariance-20260805/VERDICT.md.
# chunkinv35/chunkinv35c pin the SAME property on the launch SKU's step35 SWA prefill arm, which
# is a SEPARATE mechanism in the same file (kernel selection keyed on the request's seq_end, not
# the chunk's t_kv) and was invisible to the qwen arm — both the prompts and the canary seam
# differ. research/step35-chunkfix-20260807. SKIPs where the artifact is not staged.
# isogap/isogapc pin the STAGGERED-DEPTH batched-decode isolation contract (decode_batch's
# rung guard + the seqs kernel's ONE-PARTITION law) — the rung-crossing shape no other arm
# reaches. research/iso-gap-20260807.
# tickinv35/tickinv35c pin the axis ONE LEVEL UP: serve splits a prompt across SEVERAL
# prime_cache CALLS (per-tick budgets + the prefix-cache LCP split), so the request-level
# seq_end must survive call boundaries too. research/tick-seg-20260807.
# ppsplit/ppsplitc pin the LEVER-B prime stage split plus dynamic microchunk scheduling:
# fixed unsplit/fixed serial versus dynamic pipeline bit-identity, split liveness, and
# concurrent-walker overlap liveness. SKIPs on single-GPU rigs; the PP-2 box battery is the
# authority. research/pp-leverb-20260807, research/microchunk-20260808.
^crates/memra-engine/src/(decode|decode_batch|forward|hybrid_forward|pp|prime_graph|graph_update|mla)\.rs$
# b2geo35/b2geo35c pin the step35 BATCHED-DECODE geometry (per-layer n_head / partial rope /
# per-session SWA views / head gate at B>1, over PP-2) + the batched-evidence teeth — the
# HTTP-200-garbage class no logit gate reaches from serve level. research/step35-batch-20260808.
^crates/memra-engine/src/(decode|decode_batch|forward|hybrid_forward|pp|prime_graph|graph_update|mla)\.rs$
# Variant-only forward paths: E4B owns PLE/KV-sharing, while KAT is the non-expert IQ4_XS trunk.
^crates/memra-engine/src/(decode|hybrid_forward)\.rs$
# amargin compares these exact two arithmetic surfaces: batched forward_last vs tokenwise decode.
# It does not execute sampled-spec control code; accept remains the served-spec/long-text gate.
^crates/memra-engine/src/(decode|forward|hybrid_forward)\.rs$
# --- engine Rust: dispatch/FFI/load seams (these ARE what kernel-check calls through) ---
^crates/memra-engine/src/(hybrid|model|mmq_ffi|f16_ffi|fp8_ffi|cutlass_ffi|lib)\.rs$
# The representatives above do not cover E4B's PLE/KV-share loader or KAT's IQ4_XS dispatch.
^crates/memra-engine/src/(hybrid|model|lib)\.rs$
# --- gate/bench binaries: build-only (they ARE the gates) ---
^crates/memra-engine/src/bin/argmax_margin_probe\.rs$
^crates/memra-engine/src/bin/
^crates/memra-engine/tests/
# --- other crates ---
^crates/memra-kv/
^crates/memra-gguf/
^crates/memra-tokenizer/
# memra-sampling: greedy goldens collapse to argmax and never run the sampler transforms —
# sampt (the crate's own unit tests) + samp (device sampler oracle) are the real gates here.
^crates/memra-sampling/
^crates/memra-runtime/
^crates/memra-validate/
# memra-server: the serving battery (tools/serve-smoke.sh) is local-ci's; what fast-gate owns
# here is the CONCURRENCY contract — sstress (c=64 streaming burst) covers the admission VRAM
# gate + step-OOM park seams that a worker.rs edit can silently break with a green build.
# Engine-side effects are covered by the DEFAULT row only if engine files are also touched.
# tickinv35: the worker's per-tick prime loop is the very segmentation the gate replicates —
# a worker.rs change to tick budgets/LCP-split chunking must re-prove tick-invariance
# (research/tick-seg-20260807; the probe's loop is a pinned replica of prefill_tick).
# b2geo35: chunk_cap_for + group_chunks live in worker.rs — a change there can silently re-pin
# step35 to B=1 (gate goes vacuous) or widen past the arm's tier; the evidence assertion catches
# both directions.
^crates/memra-server/
# --- no-gate paths ---
^tools/argmax-margin-gate\.sh$
^(docs/|research/|agent-knowledge/|probe/|\.github/|tools/)
^[^/]*\.(md|svg|png|txt|json|lock)$
# --- DEFAULT (first column literally "DEFAULT"): applied ONLY to files no row above
# matched — it never escalates a file that already has a scoped plan. Conservative. ---
DEFAULT
